TOPIC 8.6 
Finding the Area Between 
Curves That Intersect at 
More Than Two Points

LEARNING OBJECTIVE

CHA-5.A
Calculate areas in the plane 
using the definite integral.

ESSENTIAL KNOWLEDGE

CHA-5.A.3
Areas of certain regions in the plane may be 
calculated using a sum of two or more definite 
integrals or by evaluating a definite integral 
of the absolute value of the difference of 
two functions.

ENDURING UNDERSTANDING

CHA-5
Definite integrals allow us to solve problems involving the accumulation of change in 
area or volume over an interval.

SUGGESTED SKILLS 

Connecting 
Representations

2.B
Identify mathematical 
information from graphical, 
numerical, analytical, and/or 
verbal representations.
